PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2015-10-26 | 372 m MD | Girujan | cementing_issue | high | 14.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Girujan.
Remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.

2015-10-26 | 512 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | high | 11.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

2015-10-28 | 1095 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 4.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 49 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 4.0 hrs.

2015-11-01 | 2854 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | medium | 8.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Kopili, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.

2015-11-01 | 2867 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | high | 7.3 hrs NPT
Cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Kopili, suspected transition zone.
Remedy: Raised mud weight in 29-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
